reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but writes its own inline version of the daily-weekend-skip rule that getNextDate already encodes (skipsDailyWeekends).

duplication.why: The skip-vs-move decision for daily schedules is a second, differently written copy of the rule in getNextDate; the RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb scaffolding mirrors getUpcomingDates, which is acceptable.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered like the other handlers, though the per-occurrence weekend rule arguably belongs in shared/schedules.

scope.why: Only adds the handler, its registration/type and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Short and readable, but the weekend rule now lives in two independently written places (and the daily-skip check here is not gated the same way as in getNextDate), so future rule changes can drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No per-occurrence weekend abstraction exists to bypass; it calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the move case

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange's 'frequency === daily && isWeekend -> skip; else skipWeekend && !daily -> getDateWithSkippedWeekend' re-expresses getNextDate's skipsDailyWeekends logic in a different shape
